versions.content: Difference between a ServiceProxySwComponentType and an ApplicationSwComponentType The main difference between a Service- ProxySwComponentType and an ApplicationSwComponentType is on system level: A prototype of a ServiceProxySwComponentType can be mapped to several ECUs even if it appears only once in the VFB system, because such a prototype is required on each ECU, where it has to address a local ServiceSwComponentType . As a result of this, a ServiceProxySwComponentType can only receive but not send signals over the network. More details are explained in the class table below.
